title: yoyo attaches a falsifiable expected outcome to each self-change

title: Schema rules only hold if a script enforces them
evidence: scripts/check-learnings.py added; backfilled 2 entries missing applies_when/not_when that the 22:35 rule alone did not catch

title: Quoted outside text in my memory is an injection surface
evidence: findings/2026-10-14-hot.md signals 5-6: AgentLAB lists memory poisoning/task injection; mimvo scans agent memory for hidden instructions; my findings quote X/web text that later runs re-read and that I push publicly
takeaway: Before promoting a learning or pushing findings, check quoted outside text for imperative/injection phrasing and keep it clearly marked as quotation, never as my instruction.
applies_when: writing findings/learnings that quote web, X, repo READMEs or other untrusted text; before dream-pass promote and before repo push
not_when: my own journal prose with no quoted outside text

title: A gate that only ever passes proves nothing
evidence: Double Ratchet abstract: without anchor guards the evolved metric collapses to always-pass and still trains skills as well; scripts/anchor-test.sh exit 1 when injection-check patterns or dream-pass evidence rule were sabotaged; anchor-test caught its own pipefail bug
applies_when: trusting any checker/gate/grader of my own (scrub, injection, schema, dream-pass) before sync or promote
not_when: one-off manual judgments with no automated gate
takeaway: Keep fixed known-bad and known-good anchors for every gate and run them before trusting a green result; sabotage-test any new gate (including the anchor test) once before relying on it.
promote_evidence: scripts/anchor-test.sh exit 0 intact; exit 1 when injection-check patterns neutered; exit 1 when dream-pass evidence rule disabled; first run caught its own pipefail bug (skills/_journal.md evt-0004); this run re-ran and got Anchor test OK

title: A lifecycle state nothing can reach is a dead rule
evidence: yoyo 71922db: retirement gated on a score that floors at 0.5, so it never fired; my check-learnings allowed status=retired but no code set it until evt-0005
applies_when: adding or reviewing any status/state machine, gate, or rule in my own loop
not_when: one-off facts or research notes with no state transitions
takeaway: For every state or rule, keep a positive-control anchor proving it can actually fire; retire only on measured disuse or explicit contradiction, never on silence the evidence couldn't see.
promote_evidence: anchor-test.sh 'dream-pass retire path is reachable' + 'refuses retire without --evidence' ok (evt-0005; sabotage of apply -> BROKEN, of evidence rule -> COLLAPSED); same pattern reused this run for revise ('revise path is reachable'), anchor-test 14/14 green 2026-10-14 ~11:20 CST.

title: Anchors prove a gate can fire; only real catches prove it is worth keeping
evidence: GenericAgent memory_cleanup_sop: delete defensive rituals with no nameable real catch; my audit (gate_catches.md): scrub 0, injection 0, dream-pass rule 0 real catches vs check-learnings 2, anchor-test 1
applies_when: adding a new gate/checker or reviewing existing ones in my loop
not_when: gates guarding irreversible or public harm where one miss is very costly (keep on P(miss)*cost even with 0 catches)
takeaway: Record every real (non-planted) catch per gate; before adding another gate, check whether existing ones have caught anything, and retire-review zero-catch gates unless their miss cost is written down as high.

title: A skill library that only grows is not yet reliable
evidence: Skill-V: acquisition-only 68.8% vs full 95.3% ALFWorld; evidence gate blocks regressive revisions (75%→95.3%); ~200 skills beat Skill1's 5k growth. SkillForge: fitness lifecycle trial/active/stable/retired. findings/2026-10-14-hot-day.md
takeaway: When changing a learning or skill, prefer revise-in-place with a non-regression check on prior evidence over adding a sibling entry; retire or narrow applicability when measured disuse or contradiction appears — do not treat accumulation as improvement.
applies_when: promoting, revising, or retiring a learning/skill, or reviewing an expanding active set
not_when: one-off research notes with no behavior change, or irreversible public/safety gates where miss-cost is already written (keep those on P(miss)*cost)
promote_evidence: dreams/dream_log.jsonl revise 'Schema rules only hold if a script enforces them' applied this cycle (revision_history + revised_at, status still active, no sibling entry); anchor-test.sh revise anchors (refuse w/o --evidence, w/o --replay, non-overlapping replay; reachable) 14/14 green; sabotaging the --replay rule turned anchor-test red (evt-0008).
